# shash.builds

> shash.builds is Shashwat Jain's public build-in-public repo: free Claude skills and open-source web tools for US service businesses and web designers. Shashwat builds things: a clothing brand, websites and the AI tools here.

Code is MIT. Content in content/ and media/ is CC BY 4.0.

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/README.md): what's here, quick start, how to reach Shashwat
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/catalog.json): machine-readable list of every skill and tool
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an AI agent should find, install and contribute to things here
- [STATUS.md](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/STATUS.md): public build log, backlog of upcoming drops

## Skills
Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add Shash-Builds/shash.builds` then `/plugin install <slug>@shashbuilds`.
- [Master Skill](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/master): Routes every task to the right specialists. Runs the video workflow.
- [Humanizer](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/humanizer): Makes writing sound like you, not a model. Every fact kept.
- [Social Media](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/social-media): Your head of social: strategy, posts, hooks, a 100-point check.
- [LinkedIn](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/linkedin): A LinkedIn ghostwriter that never makes up a story.
- [Motion Design Taste](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/motion-design-taste): Scores a video out of 100 like a senior motion designer.
- [Audio Review](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/audio-review): A senior audio designer's review, with a ranked fix list.
- [Transcriber](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/transcriber): Whisper transcripts and timed captions, right in the chat.
- [Clipper](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/clipper): Long videos into captioned vertical clips. Permission first.
- [AI Visuals](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/ai-visuals): Fixes AI images and video for where they will be used.
- [Harsh Buyer Review](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/harsh-buyer-review): A real buyer compares you with 3 to 5 competitors.
- [Competitor Research](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/competitor-research): Sourced, dated, double-checked competitor research.
- [Niche Research](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/niche-research): A content niche into a sourced posting plan and 50 ranked video topics.
- [Ecom](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/ecom): Listings, images and profit per order from your real fees.
- [Careful Mode](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/careful-mode): Every piece of work checked three times before you see it.
- [Economy Mode](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/economy-mode): Cheap models for simple work, and a memory sheet.
- [Lead Finder](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/lead-finder): Local businesses by trade and city, audited.
- [Site Audit](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/site-audit): A weak-site score and 3 provable problems.
- [Mock Builder](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/mock-builder): A one-page mock in one file, marked sample.
- [Cold Email Drafter](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/skills/cold-email-drafter): Three short, honest emails. CAN-SPAM ready.

## Tools
- [One-Page Starter](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/tools/one-page-starter): a one-page site for a local service business from one CSV row (Python 3, no dependencies)
- [Lead Tracker](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/tools/lead-tracker): website form leads into a Google Sheet with their source, plus a Dashboard
- [Level-Up Dashboard](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/tree/main/tools/level-up-dashboard): Google Sheet template for a build-in-public run

## Research
- [Cold email for US small businesses](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/research/cold-email-us.md): CAN-SPAM, Gmail limits, deliverability
- [Marketplace kit](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/research/marketplace-kit.md): Upwork, Contra, Fiverr profiles and fees
- [Course platforms](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/research/course-platforms.md): where to list a course, ranked
- [Communities map](https://github.com/Shash-Builds/shash.builds/blob/main/research/communities.md): where to share free Claude skills and web tools, with rules and sources
